City Opens Its First Solar-Powered Library

By Maya Chen

The city opened its first solar-powered library on Tuesday after two years of construction and neighborhood planning.

The building produces enough electricity for its reading rooms, public computers, and evening community programs.

“This library belongs to everyone,” Mayor Luis Ortega said during the opening ceremony.

Residents can use the new facility seven days a week, and the city expects more than two hundred thousand visits each year.

The project also restored a public garden beside the entrance and added safe bicycle parking for local families.
